title: v1.2.7 vs main@03d9b87 release-level endpoint A/B
purpose: Performance and regression gate for v1.2.8. Not a capacity or SLA proof.

B.label: main
B.platform_source_equivalence: git diff 56dc914..03d9b87 over prototypes/v1/platform, prototypes/v1/src, prototypes/v1/controller and scripts is empty; the two builds differ only in embedded VCS metadata

embedded_binaries_excluded.reason: The v1.2.7 release protocol excluded the image's own binaries because CI build flags/toolchain are not the measured pair; both arms mount the same locally built binaries into the same image.

launcher.note: Same launcher mounted on both arms; it differs from the image's dev.py only by forwarding PERI_DEFERRED_SESSION_CLOSE to the platform child.

runtime.volumes: fresh named volume per leg, prefix peri-r73-release-; old volumes are never reused or deleted

X1.concurrency.diagnostic: c16 is diagnostic only; its default-quota 429s are recorded, never used to excuse c8

W1.insert.pairing: ordered pairs (r1-a1 vs r1-b1), (r1-b2 vs r1-a2), (r2-b1 vs r2-a1), (r2-a2 vs r2-b2)

analysis.percentile: sorted ascending, index min(n-1, int(n*p/100)) (same as Issue 28 / R72)
analysis.pair_p50_ratio: median(B leg p50 / A leg p50) over the defined pairs
analysis.pooled_p95_ratio: p95 of all timed samples pooled per side, B/A
analysis.x1_throughput: 1000 * requests / elapsed_ms for the c8 level; per-side median of 4 legs; ratio B/A
analysis.c8_throughput: summary.timed.throughput_qps per leg; per-side median of 4 legs; ratio B/A

invalid_if: container failed to start, connection.json missing, or stack health not reached
fixture import incomplete or seed verification line missing
driver/harness exit non-zero because of transport or environment failure
timed sample count differs from the frozen count
429 / rate-limit or quota refusal in any non-X1-c16 leg
metrics, audit, launcher-stop or binary identity evidence missing/unreadable
invalid_leg_policy.rerun: A leg declared invalid may be rerun once for the same arm with a new volume and a new port. Valid legs are never rerun. If the rerun is also invalid, report ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED if the cause is clearly environmental; otherwise FAIL.
invalid_leg_policy.forbidden: No quota relaxation, no observer enablement, no criteria change, no dropping/replacing a valid leg after seeing its result.

invariants_per_leg: container platform and worker SHA256 equal the frozen arm values
no observer environment variable is present in the platform process
metrics error and rejection deltas are empty (X1 c16 rate_limit only, diagnostic)
audit chain continuous and head matches tail; audit count grows
end state session_seats=0, active_permits=0, unknown_held_permits=0, worker sessions=0, pending close=0
launcher-stop outcome=clean, reason=terminal_proof_written, unresolved_operations=false; docker stop exit 0
F1 modal response 312 bytes / 1 row; L1 modal response 15627 bytes / 40 rows / rows_read 201
B default publishes deferred_session_close and drains to pending=0; A publishes no such key

T8.workload: 5 timed json-pipeline F1 requests (execute SELECT 1 + close)
pass: no deferred_session_close key in before/after metrics
cleanup_ledger.pending_close=0 and worker sessions=0 immediately after the burst
control run with the switch unset publishes the key with enqueued_total>0
T8.note: T8 does not participate in the performance verdict; it is a release blocker.

T1.arm: B platform built from main plus probe/r71-g3-fault-injection (090aad5) cherry-picked; B worker
T1.workload: 4 concurrent Hrana pipeline [execute SELECT 1, close] requests, then immediately docker stop -t 60
pass: docker stop waits for the deferred close (platform stage waited_ms>=1800)
4 close records in a continuous audit chain
pending=0 and failed=0 before the clean terminal is written (evidenced by clean stop after drain and zero unresolved/failed log lines)
T1.fallback: If the probe cannot be rebuilt, cite R71 Gate 3 T1 evidence and mark 'not rerun in this release candidate'. Rebuild is feasible, so this fallback is not expected.

verdict_rule.PASS: every mandatory scenario meets its thresholds; every per-leg invariant passes; T8 and T1 pass (or T1 is explicitly cited under the frozen fallback).
verdict_rule.FAIL: any mandatory threshold or invariant fails, including any reproducible >10% core-scenario regression.
verdict_rule.ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED: an unrecoverable environment problem prevents a leg or the whole campaign; the exact failure and attempted recovery must be in the evidence.
verdict_rule.H1: optional; if skipped, state so and do not count it as PASS.
